name: InputProfilePhotoAnimated
description: An animated profile photo in the MPEG4 format.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the profile photo, must be _animated_

fields.name: animation
fields.description: The animated profile photo. Profile photos can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file\_attach\_name>” if the photo was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file\_attach\_name>. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)

fields.name: main_frame_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp in seconds of the frame that will be used as the static profile photo. Defaults to 0.0.
